اغرندوا (form IIIq)
# اِغْرَنْدَوْا (iḡrandaw) /iɣ.ran.daw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اُغْرُنْدُوا (uḡrundū) /uɣ.run.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اِغْرَنْدُوا (iḡrandū) /iɣ.ran.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
